name: Audit Board
purpose: this board is the wall-mounted summary of recent audit verdicts.
concierge_blurb: A board where the building's own self-checks are pinned for all to see. Red marks invite attention, not blame.

live_signals.traffic_light_reason: rows record only that a check ran (kind/target/ts); no pass|fail verdict field is emitted yet — amber by convention until the verdict field is added

lessons_learned_for_next_agent: qsb_f47_audit_checks.jsonl rows today carry only {kind, target, frequency, ts, worker_id, role, floor} — there is NO verdict field, so pass:fail ratios cannot be computed. Traffic_light defaults to amber. The next agent wiring an auditor should extend the row schema with verdict:'pass'|'fail' + optional evidence_pointer; then the descriptor can flip green/red honestly. Per the brief: NEVER expose operator notes or internal reasons on this board — track + verdict + ts only.
